name: Kazu-nee
source:
He works at a bar in the commercial district close to the maintenance agents Maho relies on for apartment repairs. He favours affectionate physical contact with Koutarou, which gives the latter the chills. 

[Spoiler] When he meets Maho and Koutarou by chance after their tryst, he finds out they are in a physical relationship and advises Koutarou to make his feelings clear in order to develop the relationship into something more tangible. [/Spoiler]
